title.narrative: Stöd till demokratiska institutioner i MENA
Support to democratic institutions in MENA

description.narrative: Programmet syftar till att stärka inkluderande och demokratiska valprocesser i MENA-regionen genom att stödja regionala plattformar, kapacitetstärka valinstitutioner och främja meningsfullt deltagande av kvinnor, ungdomar och marginaliserade grupper.

The program aims to strengthen inclusive and democratic electoral processes in the MENA region by supporting regional platforms, enhancing the capacity of electoral institutions, and promoting meaningful participation of women, youth, and marginalized groups.

The aim of the ASPIRE initiative (The Arab States Partnership for Inclusive Rights in Elections) is to support and strengthen electoral processes in the Arab States through a rights-based approach. The initiative seeks to enhance the integrity, transparency, and inclusiveness of electoral systems, promote greater political participation, and ensure sustainable electoral reforms. By focusing on these goals, the ASPIRE initiative aims to contribute to the development of democratic governance and the protection of electoral rights in the region.
The program is orgnized around the following outputs:
Output 1: More Inclusive, Effective, and Sustainable Regional Electoral Institutions This output focuses on strengthening regional platforms to support national electoral systems. It enhances electoral standards and addresses emerging challenges such as AI and misinformation. It also builds the capacity and sustainability of regional bodies like ArabEMBs and LAS, while ensuring regional progress translates into national impact through targeted support and alignment with regional standards.
Output 2: Improved Electoral Integrity and Accountability This output promotes electoral integrity through a human rights-based approach, digital tools, and data-driven advocacy. It supports monitoring of electoral rights violations, equips institutions to counter digital threats using platforms like eMonitor, and enhances research and knowledge-sharing through data collection and academic partnerships.
Output 3: Greater Inclusive Participation in Elections This output encourages the political participation of women, youth, and persons with disabilities. It advances womens roles through networks and gender mainstreaming, strengthens youth engagement via forums and data tools, and promotes accessibility and inclusive policies for persons with disabilities through research and dialogue with regional institutions.
